acceptance_criteria.description: RegionEndpointRouter resolves CN (+86/0086) and Global calling codes to observed auth URLs when configured, keeps FCT-003 test/offline configs isolated, and rejects invalid region codes cleanly.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-301: Region routing table asserts grit-cloud.cn (+86/0086) vs grit-cloud.com (+1/+44) and rejects blank/malformed region codes.

acceptance_criteria.description: UriValidator and EndpointTrustPolicy enforce exact approved origin checks, reject unapproved HTTPS/WSS hosts, userinfo, and credential query params/fragments, disable production trust until FCT-004, and isolate TestLoopbackTrustPolicy to loopback IPs.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-309: Negative origin, userinfo, query-secret, disabled-production-policy, and non-loopback DNS/IP destination tests fail closed before I/O.

acceptance_criteria.description: Credential-bearing HTTP clients disable automatic redirects (followRedirects=false/followSslRedirects=false), retain standard TLS verification, and forbid trust-all verifiers and global SSL factory mutations.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-309, TEST-AUTH-301: MockWebServer 302/307/308 redirect tests confirm 1 request with zero forwarded headers; static scan confirms zero setDefaultSSLSocketFactory or trust-all TLS.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pure Kotlin com.weback.robot.domain defines typed auth contracts with zero Android, coroutine, serialization, or OkHttp imports and secret-safe overridden toString().
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-302, TEST-AUTH-308: DomainPurityTest asserts zero prohibited imports; AuthModelsTest asserts credential model toString() masks secrets.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttpAuthGateway serializes POST login envelope with configurable protocolApiVersion (never 0.1.0-alpha), isolated Utf8TlsDefault PasswordDigestStrategy, and token/region headers attached only after trust and expiry checks.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-302: MockWebServer RecordedRequest inspection verifies POST JSON shape, opt='login', configurable protocolApiVersion, token/region headers, and zero query credentials.

acceptance_criteria.description: Negative auth responses (HTTP 401/403/5xx, 3xx redirects, malformed JSON, code != 1, empty/untrusted token/URLs/region, expired_time <= 0) fail closed to AuthResult.Failure without mutating active sessions.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-303: Fault-injected MockWebServer negative response matrix verifies AuthResult.Failure and preserved prior valid session state.

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionStateMachine and SessionCoordinator model mutually exclusive states using single-flight Mutex, short-held commitLock, and serialized persistence boundary without holding locks across network I/O or backoff delays.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-304: Concurrent coroutine signIn tests assert single gateway dispatch and deterministic non-blocking FSM transitions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Serialized persistence contract (persistenceMutex + epoch-fenced store ops) requires TokenStore.save() before durable Authenticated, clears caches/WS/storage under NonCancellable cleanup on signOut, rejects failed-clear durable logout, and blocks failed-logout restart resurrection.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-304: Fault-injected TokenStore save/clear failure, cancellation, and post-failed-logout restart simulation tests verify durable commit ordering.

acceptance_criteria.description: sessionEpoch governs TokenStore operations, concurrent signIn/refresh, logout during login/persist, Account A->B switching, late HTTP/401 callbacks, inventory caches, selected device, WS instances, and telemetry.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-311, TEST-AUTH-304: Rapid Account A->B switch and late-epoch HTTP/401 callback tests verify superseded epoch effects are discarded without mutating Account B.

acceptance_criteria.description: TokenExpiryPolicy evaluates 80% proactive renewal and 100% expiration via AuthMonotonicClock (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()) and checked Long arithmetic (sub/add/mul), enforces immediate pre-send and post-response expiry checks, and fails closed on overflow or invalid values.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-305, TEST-AUTH-310: Boundary table (2880000ms vs 2880001ms, 3599999ms vs 3600000ms), Long overflow checks, pre-send block, and in-flight expiry discard tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.description: PersistedSessionRecord never resets lifetime on reload, preserves remaining lifetime on verified same-boot restart, transitions to ReauthenticationRequired on device reboot or clock rollback, and ignores unverified JWT claims.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-310: Deterministic restart (priorElapsedMs preserved), reboot, clock rollback, and unverified JWT exp claim ignore tests verify conservative ReauthenticationRequired.

acceptance_criteria.description: Optional RefreshGrantStrategy remains synthetic/disabled in production (defaulting to ReauthenticationRequired), and plaintext passwords/MD5 digests are never persisted or replayed.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-305: Synthetic single-flight refresh test and production-disabled ReauthenticationRequired default verify zero password/MD5 storage or replay.

acceptance_criteria.description: KeystoreAeadTokenStore uses non-exportable AndroidKeyStore AES-256-GCM (randomizedEncryptionRequired, cipher-generated 12B IV, 128-bit tag, canonical AAD, 29..16384B bounds, atomic replace in noBackupFilesDir) with zero EncryptedSharedPreferences or software fallback.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-306: AEAD storage test verifies envelope layout, distinct cipher-generated 12B IVs, AAD binding, atomic replacement, and zero EncryptedSharedPreferences/software fallback.

acceptance_criteria.description: Missing key w/ orphaned blob, AEADBadTagException, KeyPermanentlyInvalidatedException, out-of-bounds size, bad schema version, or post-decrypt validation error deletes blob/invalidated key and fails closed; mutable buffers are wiped in finally blocks.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-307: Bit-flip, version/AAD mismatch, truncation/oversize, missing key, invalidation, bad post-decrypt JSON, and I/O fault tests verify atomic wipe and fail-closed errors.

acceptance_criteria.description: Deny-by-default DiagnosticLogger logs only allowlisted safe categories/fields, credential models mask toString(), and SecretRedactor scrubs headers, opaque/JWT tokens, nested/malformed JSON, URL-encoded secrets, and exceptions.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-308: Log sink, model toString(), and SecretRedactor tests verify zero raw secret exposure across headers, opaque tokens, JWTs, nested/malformed JSON, URL-encoded strings, and exceptions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hardware-backed Keystore protection is verified on a real Android >= 12 device via KeyInfo.getSecurityLevel() (TEE/StrongBox), remaining NOT_RUN in offline CI without an authorized device and blocking T4 hardware/release closure.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-312: Device instrumentation test checks KeyInfo.getSecurityLevel() in {TRUSTED_ENVIRONMENT, STRONGBOX} (NOT_RUN in offline CI when no authorized device attached).

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttpDeviceInventoryGateway validates trust and pre-send expiry/epoch, disables redirects, posts opt=user_thing_list_get with token/region headers, and parses via kotlinx.serialization.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-301: MockWebServer asserts exact POST JSON opt=user_thing_list_get, token/region headers, redirect blocking, and parsed ThingBean list.

acceptance_criteria.description: Missing thing_name, non-1 code, HTTP/redirect errors, stale sessionEpoch, or malformed JSON fail safely while valid empty thing_list returns InventoryState.Empty cleanly.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-301: Negative inventory payloads assert typed ConnectivityError while valid empty list asserts InventoryState.Empty.

acceptance_criteria.description: Initial thing_status telemetry hydrates into bounded RobotState fields (battery 0..100 clamped safely, isAdmin preserved) and inventory caches are scoped to active sessionEpoch.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-302: Boundary test asserts out-of-range battery and unrecognized working_status hydrate cleanly without unhandled exceptions.

acceptance_criteria.description: DeviceCapabilityClassifier normalizes sub_type prefixes grounded in enums/p.java and utils/c.java (Laser P0, VisualGyro q1, Gyro l1/L0, Camera n1, Peripherals m1/N0/Y0/v0/g1, Legacy H0/U0, Unknown).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-303: Exhaustive RE-grounded prefix table (including yg-yw10001-, xs-x8-, yw-vs01-, xs-x5c2-) verifies classification and case-insensitivity.

acceptance_criteria.description: Capability gating restricts MVP shadow control strictly to compatible Laser SLAM (P0) devices and marks peripherals, cameras, legacy XMPP, q1/gyro, and unknowns unsupported safely.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-303: ControlCompatibility mapping confirms only P0 LaserSlam returns MvpSupportedShadowWs while excluded classes return Unsupported.

acceptance_criteria.description: RealtimeSessionTransport exposes ConnectionState StateFlow with (sessionEpoch, connectionGeneration) fencing and short-held commitLock with zero locks across I/O or sleeps.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-304, TEST-CONN-308: Concurrent connect/disconnect/send MockWebServer tests verify ordered non-blocking ConnectionState emissions and generation isolation.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttpWebSocketTransport enforces trust/expiry pre-connect, sends token/region upgrade headers, parses thing_status_update frames, applies 20s outbound send-stall + 4s virtual-time reconnect, and sends close 1000.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-304: MockWebServer WebSocket contract tests assert upgrade headers, telemetry frames, 20s send-stall trigger, 4s reconnect timing, and close frame 1000.

acceptance_criteria.description: HTTP 401/403/3xx WS upgrade rejection OR session expiry/invalidation while already connected stops outbound activity and telemetry, cancels reconnects, closes socket, and triggers epoch-checked invalidation; idempotent close() blocks post-close mutations.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-305: 401/403/302 handshake and connected-socket expiry tests verify 0 reconnect retries, stopped telemetry/outbound sends, and auth callback; close race test proves zero post-close mutation.

acceptance_criteria.description: WebSocket instances and delayed reconnect jobs are fenced by (sessionEpoch, connectionGeneration) so superseded callbacks or timers cannot mutate state.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-308: Superseded epoch/generation callback and pending reconnect timer tests verify zero state mutation or duplicate sockets.

acceptance_criteria.description: Inbound telemetry validates sessionEpoch, connectionGeneration, selected thing_name, and MvpSupportedShadowWs capability; unknown/unsupported/unselected frames never mutate RobotState.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-309: Negative telemetry frames for unselected, unknown, or unsupported devices confirm RobotState remains unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.description: OfflineFixtureAuthGateway, OfflineFixtureInventoryGateway, and OfflineFixtureRealtimeTransport enable complete offline flows preserving OFFLINE simulator identity.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-306: AppContainer and offline fixture integration test runs signIn -> inventory -> capability -> WS events offline cleanly.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttp gateways and WebSocket transport execute hermetically against local MockWebServer bound via TestLoopbackTrustPolicy blocking public DNS/external hosts.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-306, TEST-AUTH-309: Loopback MockWebServer contract suite runs offline in unit tests and blocks any external DNS/TCP destination.

acceptance_criteria.description: Active policies/checks.json, verification/, workflows, and offline AndroidManifest.xml (zero INTERNET permission until isolated FCT-004 policy transition) remain preserved.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307: spec-hygiene, android-lint, android-build, and apk-validation confirm zero unapproved manifest permissions or policy edits.

acceptance_criteria.description: ConnectivityError maps auth, redirect, trust, expiry, challenge, timeout, network, handshake, storage, and unsupported device failures to safe allowlisted UI errors.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307, TEST-AUTH-308: Error mapping tests verify every ConnectivityError variant formats safe guidance without raw tokens or stack traces.

acceptance_criteria.description: WebSocket disconnects preserve committed RobotState telemetry within active sessionEpoch/selected device, block remote sends while disconnected, and clear state on logout/switch.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307, TEST-CONN-308: Disconnect recovery test asserts committed RobotState survives socket loss, remote send returns Rejected, and logout clears state.

acceptance_criteria.description: All existing 54 FCT-001/FCT-002 unit and Robolectric Compose UI tests plus 7-check policy execution remain non-regressed.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307: Full testDebugUnitTest + 7-check candidate pipeline confirms all 54 FCT-001/FCT-002 regressions and spec-hygiene pass.
